title: OH Lord we plead Thee spare us

lines.text: OH Lord we plead Thee spare us
In Thee all our trust repose
Our souls speaketh unto God
Thou, and Thou alone is our God.
Beside Thee, we have no goodness
In Thee all our trust repose
Surrender us not to our foes
Victory be ours home and abroad.
Unto the saints here on earth
And unto the excellent
In whom is all my delight
There in shall be for ever.
Their sorrows shall multiply
That hasten after other gods
Their blood offering I abhor
Nor their drink will I offer.
The Lord is all my portion
Inheritance of my cup
Thou who main-tain-eth my lot
Lest my foes make it corrupt.
The line is fallen on me
Moreso on pleasant places
Verily I can confirm
Yea I have goodly heritage.
I will bless the Lord my God
Who hath given me counsel
My reins also, me instruct
In the seasons of the night.
The Lord have I set before me
Through all stratas of my life
For He is at my right hand
I shall not forever be moved.
Therefore my heart is so glad
And my glory rejoiceth
Thus my flesh also shall rest
In eternal hope and life.
Thou shan't leave my soul in hell
Neither in the grave beneath
Neither will Thine Holy One
See corruption nor decay.
Thou will shew me path of life
Before Thee is fulness of joy
At Thy right hand plenty of joy
And pleasures for ever more.
Protect the Band of Seraphim
And the Band of Cherubim
Those who worship Thee in truth
All over the universe.
Let’s offer praise to the Father
And praise also to the Son
Let us praise the Holy Spirit
The Eternal Trinity.
